minutes.headline: Committee approved the amended RFQ for TC Passios design services and set January interview dates.
minutes.summary: The committee went through the draft request for qualifications for design services, covering the submission deadline, community forums, interviews, evaluation criteria and which end users the design should serve. The RFQ was approved as amended. The members set an advertising date, January review and interview meetings, and moved the December 18 meeting to 6 pm followed by a building tour.

public_comment.topic: A speaker said the RFQ should address whether base construction is needed and require a written report on temporary space during construction. The speaker also thought the February to April design timeline was tight.

votes.motion: Approve the request for qualifications as amended.

budget_items.what_was_said: Members noted that the appropriation would need a two-thirds vote, and discussed whether a special or the annual Town Meeting fits.
Members worried that a design scope that is too broad would drive up project cost and that the tax rate was a Town Meeting concern.

decisions.decision: The RFQ would be advertised in the Central Register around the 11th of December.
Proposals would be reviewed at the January 8 meeting, with interviews set for the 22nd and 29th.
The RFQ would cap community forums at a maximum of three.
The December 18 meeting moves to 6 pm, with a building tour afterward.

The request would be advertised in the Central Register around December 11, with community forums capped at a maximum of three.
Proposals would be reviewed at the January 8 meeting, with interviews set for January 22 and 29.

why_it_matters: The RFQ sets what the design firm is asked to do, and members tied a broad design scope to higher project cost, which would reach residents as a tax rate question at Town Meeting.
Any appropriation for the project needs a two-thirds vote at Town Meeting, so residents will likely be asked to vote on it, and the choice of a special or annual meeting is still open.
